attributes.title: Latest forensics (click one to open it, or its function)

kibanaSavedObjectMeta.searchSourceJSON: {"query":{"query":"source = logs-otel-v1* | where isnotnull(`attributes.hud.forensic.type`) and `attributes.hud.issue.sources` like '%:$function%' | sort - time | head 200 | eval Forensic = _id, Exception = json_extract(body, '$.exceptions[0].name'), Message = json_extract(body, '$.exceptions[0].message'), `Duration ms` = round(cast(json_extract(body, '$.duration') as double) / 1000000, 1) | parse `attributes.hud.issue.sources` '^\\\\[?(?<Error>[^@]+)@(?<File>[^:]+):(?<Function>.*?)\\\\]?$' | eval Error = if(isnull(Error) or Error = '', json_extract(body, '$.exceptions[0].name'), Error), Error = if(isnull(Error), json_extract(body, '$.context.response_body.error'), Error), Error = if(isnull(Error), `attributes.hud.issue.framework_result`, Error), Function = if(isnull(Function) or Function = '', json_extract(body, '$.exceptions[0].executionFlow[0].function[\"code.function.name\"]'), Function) | rename `resource.attributes.service.name` as Service, `attributes.code.flow.name` as Endpoint, `attributes.hud.forensic.type` as Type, `attributes.http.response.status_code` as Status, `attributes.hud.issue.fingerprint` as Fingerprint | fields Forensic, time, Service, Endpoint, Type, Status, `Duration ms`, Exception, Message, Function, Fingerprint","language":"PPL","dataset":{"id":"f2654070-c6dd-11f1-a994-5ff5adef1b8f","title":"logs-otel-v1*","type":"INDEX_PATTERN","timeFieldName":"time","dataSource":{}}},"filter":[],"indexRefName":"kibanaSavedObjectMeta.searchSourceJSON.index"}
